grades.quote: The rest of the bits in the CSR remain unchanged
grades.reason: Describes LoongArch CSRXCHG, which uses a write mask in rj to update only selected CSR bits while leaving the rest unchanged. This directly answers the query.
Covers how CSR values are derived when a CSR's width changes. It does not cover selectively updating CSR bits without overwriting other fields.
Covers OS capability-based protection and revocation. It has nothing to do with changing selected control register bits.
Describes the sctrdepth register and its DEPTH field. It does not explain how to modify selected CSR bits while preserving other fields.
